messages:
support-ops: Heads up — support ticket requesting per-chunk ACKs for streaming completions + resumable fncall fragments.
support-ops: Customer use-case: long chat sessions that invoke tools. They want to ACK intermediate chunks so server can evict KV cache earlier and bound memory.
josiah: Can you paste the ticket excerpt? Need to decide backlog vs short-term workaround.
support-ops: Ticket excerpt:
```
client: openStream({stream_schema: "json-lines", resume_token: true, ack_window: 3})
server chunks:
 {"partial":{"step":1,"cursor":1}}
 {"partial":{"step":2,"cursor":2}}
 {"tool_call":{"name":"lookup","args":{}}}
```
They want to ack cursor 1 and 2 to free memory asap.
maya: Quick tech note — current stream proto only sends deltas + end-of-stream. No dedicated client->server control messages for ACK. Adding one is feasible but touches runtime backpressure and eviction hooks.
josiah: Prioritization context? customer tier / SLA?
elaine: Sales confirms two paying customers: a fintech customer with compliance needs and a marketplace. Both want deterministic memory bounds and resume ability.
josiah: High-level proposal:
- API: optional ack_window + resume_token flag in openStream. ack_window hints how many in-flight chunks to keep.
- Server: emit resume_token on commit. Client can resume with resumeStream(token) to rehydrate last K tokens.
- Gating: opt-in per-org or feature flag for backwards compat.
- Launch criteria: e2e correctness tests, perf within 10% p99, SDK examples, 2 pilot customers.
maya: Impl tasks: runtime control channel, eviction hook, per-resume_token storage of frames, SDK auto-ack helpers, console metrics for resumed sessions. Rough estimate: 3 sprints + 1 dogfood sprint.
josiah: Risks: resume_token security (opaque + expiry), storage cost per token, rollout canary complexity.
prod-bot: Created ticket TKT-4321 linking FIN-123. Perf job enqueued.
elaine: Customer also asks partial fncall support: stream fncall args over multiple chunks and validate schema per-chunk, final commit triggers strict validation.
maya: Approach: stream fncall pieces as json-lines with schema-id header, runtime aggregates until final commit then validates. Allow soft-warn on chunk validation, hard on final.
josiah: Next steps:
- Maya spike: design control channel + resume token (1 week)
- Support-ops: qualify pilot customers, capture explicit acceptance criteria (e.g., resume within 5s, eviction deterministic)
- DevEx: SDK ergonomics + examples
- Product: slot into Q3 candidate bucket; require 2 pilot thumbs-up to GA-prioritize.
support-ops: Will follow up with customers and paste acceptance wording here.
josiah: Adding label streaming-ack-resume and backlog item. Reassign when spike PR lands.
maya: proto sketch for control messages:
```
message StreamControl {
  oneof body {
    Ack ack = 1;
    Resume resume = 2;
  }
}
message Ack { int64 cursor = 1; }
message Resume { string token = 1; }
```
josiah: Great — keep updates in thread. :thumbsup:
